note: An RV-only campground behind the day-use beach on the southwest shore of Lake Winnipesaukee, with a 600-ft sandy beach and views to the Sandwich and Ossipee ranges. Every camper must hook up to all three services and be self-contained; no tents (pop-ups only if hooked up), no fire rings and no pets. Recommended in _Where_Should_We_Camp_Next?_ by Stephanie Puglisi. --Claude
